description: This PHP source file defines the JobTitleDao class, which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations and queries related to job titles within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for listing, filtering, counting, and managing JobTitle entities, as well as handling associated job specification attachments.

classes.name: JobTitleDao
classes.description: Data access object class for managing JobTitle entities and related data operations in the system.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active JobTitle entities, optionally filtering only active ones, and ordering by job title name.

methods.name: getJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a list of JobTitle entities associated with a specific employee, including active titles and titles linked to the employee.

methods.name: getJobTitles
methods.description: Fetches job titles based on provided search filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getJobTitlesPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator object for job titles based on search filters, including sorting and filtering for active titles.

methods.name: getJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of job titles matching specific search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Marks specified JobTitle entities as deleted in the database.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobTitle entity by its ID if it exists.

methods.name: getExistingJobTitleIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing JobTitle entities from a list of IDs, filtering out deleted ones.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobSpecificationAttachment entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Saves or updates a JobTitle entity in the database.

methods.name: deleteJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Removes a JobSpecificationAttachment entity from the database.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationByJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves a partial job specification attachment associated with a specific job title ID.
